cases.contract_focus: Counts compositions of the ordered position sequence, not equivalence classes of equal symbols.

cases.contract_focus: A permutation of parts does not restore the source occurrence order.

cases.contract_focus: Equal values cannot merge different source positions or erase distinct cuts.

cases.contract_focus: Coverage, adjacency, non-overlap and endpoint identity are separately necessary.

cases.contract_focus: Opaque class names and policy vocabulary are not observations of a linguistic class.

cases.contract_focus: Positive control: the conditional law must succeed when its declared, correctly bound premises are supplied.

cases.contract_focus: Reject the conflicting proposal; do not confuse a counter-witness with missing information.
cases.title_ar: المخالفة الصريحة ترفض هذا المرشح

cases.contract_focus: Identical spelling cannot transfer occurrence, scope, host or source revision identity.

cases.contract_focus: Class in one alternative and host compatibility in another cannot form one licensed alternative.

cases.contract_focus: The algebra may combine proved premises; it must not claim to discover them from its conjunction or accept a caller mask as proof.

cases.contract_focus: Conditional conclusions track the exact supplied premise set. Replay is not evidence that its source assertions are true.
cases.title_ar: سحب المصدر يبطل الاعتماد دون محو السطح

cases.contract_focus: A letter in an affix inventory can be a root slot in a separately supported analysis.

cases.contract_focus: Four independently indexed slots; traditional repeated weight letters must not identify different radical slots.

cases.contract_focus: Root extraction, pattern refill and surface partition are different judgments; a matching فاعل shape is not a syntactic subject.
cases.title_ar: الجذر إسقاط خانات داخل القالب وليس مقطعًا متجاورًا

cases.contract_focus: A template cannot skip a conflicting internal literal to force its expected root or class.
cases.title_ar: الحركة الداخلية المخالفة تمنع هذا القالب

cases.contract_focus: Positive article control is conditional on an explicit class/host/link witness, not on the literal prefix alone.

cases.contract_focus: Preserve أ vs ا; literal mismatch rejects only the asserted prefix match.

cases.contract_focus: Whole-lexeme evidence and substring evidence have different subjects; the referent and relative return are additional obligations.

cases.contract_focus: This is a declared grammatical interpretation, not proof that every ال is a particle or that a complete relative relation is acquired.

cases.contract_focus: Terminal shape is insufficient to distinguish a radical from a clitic.

cases.contract_focus: A licensed attached form does not identify its referent or assert possession as a world fact.

cases.contract_focus: Both analyses are supplied alternatives. The test measures preservation, not discovery of their pronunciation or class.

cases.contract_focus: A final written ت may be lexical material; suffix inventory membership is not a classification witness.
cases.title_ar: التاء في بيت أصل لا علامة تأنيث

cases.contract_focus: A formal suffix observation cannot overrule the independent lexical-semantic premise.
cases.title_ar: التاء المربوطة لا تنقض شاهد المذكر والعلمية

cases.contract_focus: Tanwin, definiteness, construction and actual syntactic case are different axes.
cases.title_ar: تنوين زيد لا يوجب النكرة

cases.contract_focus: The person prefix is licensed within a supplied paradigm; the letter ن does not prove person or verbhood.
cases.title_ar: نون المضارعة في عائلة مصرح بها

cases.contract_focus: Pronoun, host and occurrence must agree. The conditional category does not run a sentence parser.
cases.title_ar: نون النسوة بضمير وعائلة وشاهد اتصال

cases.contract_focus: A supplied full connection witness licenses directness; shadda is retained on one source cluster.
cases.title_ar: التوكيد المباشر يحتاج شاهدًا زائدًا على الرسم

cases.contract_focus: Surface adjacency or an annotation label cannot eliminate a possibly unwritten separator in the analysis.
cases.title_ar: وسم EMPH وحده لا يحسم المباشرة والفصل

cases.contract_focus: The host and first-person suffix witness the conditional protection analysis; grammatical role needs its own relation.
cases.title_ar: نون الوقاية ليست نون رفع ولا ضمير نسوة

cases.contract_focus: Coexisting roles belong to different full clusters inside one reading; one type must not overwrite the other.
cases.title_ar: نون أصلية ونون إعراب في القراءة نفسها

cases.contract_focus: Same written ون needs different host evidence; a nominative-looking ending does not supply an actual syntactic role.
cases.title_ar: نون الجمع الاسمي غير نون الأمثلة الخمسة

cases.contract_focus: A missing segment is represented in a witnessed correspondence, not as an invented zero-length or nonempty source span.
cases.title_ar: غياب النون لا يثبت حذفها إلا بقاعدة تامة

cases.contract_focus: Preserve the supplied paradigm ambiguity; a prefix inventory is not a person/reference classifier.
cases.title_ar: تاء المضارعة لا تعين المخاطب وحده

cases.contract_focus: Underlying allomorphy and literal segmentation remain separate. An absent alif gets no fabricated source bytes.
cases.title_ar: لام الجر وأل المنكمشة تحفظان السطح دون ألف مخترعة

explicit_nonclaims: No free-text lexical category, root, person, gender, nun type or attachment acquisition is measured.
No probability of Arabic correctness is inferred from cut counts or Bell numbers.
No success is claimed for discovering an ON/FOR rule from a prewritten gate inventory.
No external corpus, heldout natural text, lexical attestation or complete Unicode tokenizer is supplied.
Arabic annotations are conditional assumptions; their truth outside this review is not proved by source hashes or Lean.

public_contract.arabic_atomization: manually declared base/marks units retaining exact UTF-8, with explicit separator units where needed; not a complete UAX implementation
public_contract.arabic_premises: explicit authored conditional assumptions, never claimed to have been acquired
public_contract.domain: List alpha with declared ordered atomization
public_contract.progress: fulfilled separately source-bound premises for unit, reading, host and rule; not a score or witness count
public_contract.runtime_schema: not fixed by this material; adapter must map equivalent public semantic judgments without changing expected predicates
public_contract.surface_partition: ordered, contiguous, nonempty parts covering each source position exactly once; empty list has one empty partition
public_contract.unit_class: opaque; spelling and enumeration do not infer its linguistic meaning

result_semantics.INVALID_CERTIFICATE: A claimed result fails replay, identity binding or provenance; a fresh linguistic result can still be UNKNOWN.
result_semantics.LICENSED: This named conditional judgment has all its declared premises bound to this reading/occurrence/rule; not a general-language or world-truth certificate.
result_semantics.REJECTED: This proposed partition, match or conditional analysis contradicts a checked condition; does not reject every Arabic reading.
result_semantics.RESOURCE_LIMIT: Separate execution status if used by a future adapter; never translated into linguistic REJECTED.
result_semantics.UNKNOWN: Required positive or negative evidence is absent, or unresolved alternatives remain; no default category may fill it.
